calls.reason: The deadline is end of 2029 and hasn't passed. The only evidence is a non-Optimus teleoperated animal study, which can't settle whether Optimus will beat top surgeons.
'Anytime soon' has no fixed deadline, and the inferred 2029 date is still ahead. The ex vivo autonomy and teleoperated humanoid studies show progress but don't decide the outcome yet.
No time limit was given for Musk to push back the date. Searches found no revised surgery deadline from Musk between August and October 2026, so nothing is settled yet.
Musk predicted AI smarter than any one human around end of 2025. ARC Prize's December 2025 analysis said AGI was 'not yet' here and gains were still narrow, so the milestone plainly wasn't met.

The Clearer Thinking audit found only about 16% of 43 timed predictions came true on time, and Reuters lists years of missed self-driving deadlines. The point that the media treat his dates as gospel is unmeasured, but the main point holds.
